q1.explanationZh: 第一段最后说，五公里的比赛叫“5k”。

q2.explanationZh: 第二段一开始就说，Lily 是在4月26日跑的。

evidence.quote: On April 26, Lily ran in the Battersea Parkrun in London.

q3.explanationZh: 第三段第一句说，Lily 的哥哥叫 Daniyal，注意拼写。

evidence.quote: Lily’s brother, Daniyal, also likes running.

q4.explanationZh: 最后一段说，她会继续努力训练，永不放弃，所以她还会继续跑。

evidence.quote: She says she will keep training hard and never give up.

q5.explanationZh: 第一句意思是“人们认为她是跑得最快的女孩”，be believed to 是“被认为”，后面接比赛 race。

evidence.quote: She is now believed to be the fastest eight-year-old girl in the world to finish a five-kilometre race

q6.explanationZh: Lily 说“当我跨过(crossed)终点线……我很开心也很骄傲(proud)”。

evidence.quote: When I crossed the finish line

q7.explanationZh: Lily 用了20分16秒，旧纪录比她慢14秒，16+14=30，所以旧纪录是20分30秒，填 record。

evidence.quote: The old record was 14 seconds slower
